'''Drixni''' was a [[Spice/Legends|drug]] [[Merchant/Legends|store]] located in [[Panna City]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Panna Prime]].
The store sold a [[Serum (sleeping virus)|serum]] that cured an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[sleeping virus]].<ref name="TSotFW" /> [[Time/Legends|Sometime]] between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' places the [[mission to Panna Prime]] after the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], which it also placed six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], corresponding to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Since {{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-holiday-special-cantina-we-may-not-thrive-friend-but-we-survive-friend|text=''The Star Wars Holiday Special'' Cantina: Who's Who|int=The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who|nolive=1}} places the events of ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the events of the mission as portrayed in ''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]'', in which Drixni appears, must have occurred between 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and 1 ABY.</ref> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] entered the store and acquired supplies of the serum for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who had been infected by the virus. A [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Clerk/Legends|clerk]] serviced the store.<ref name="TSotFW" />

Drixni had pink-colored walls and a showcase in which the serum was exposed and advertised. The name of the shop was [[Writing/Legends|written]] in the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]] on the showcase and on a yellow awning.<ref name="TSotFW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Drixni appeared in the animated story "[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]" that aired in [[1978]] as part of made-for-TV-film ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''.<ref name="TSotFW" /> The story was written by [[George Lucas]] and produced by [[Nelvana]] Studios.<ref name="Tooning Out">{{SWArchive|url=movies/saga/20081210.html|text=Tooning Out the "Holiday Special": Nelvana Studios}}</ref>

In the non-[[canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]'', developed by [[Wikipedia:Disney Mobile|Disney Mobile]] and published in [[2013]], Drixni was a drugstore in Panna City that sold medicines for common and exotic diseases.<ref name="TLS">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''</ref>
